normal.name: Ongaku Overdrive 🎃 October 24th
normal.text: THERE'S A BELMONT IN THE CASTLE?! For the first time ib years, a NEW CastleVania game is out. The horrible night is over! Be sure to get Belmont's Curse, preferably from OngakuVania sponsor Cybertron Video Games. We might have an extra copy to raffle next week!

normal.name: Evangeline Sorrel
normal.text: Like in a video game where you can have pop ups that explain mechanics (as it does) why do you need the only characterisation of both the protagonist and first boss in this small demo be so fucking childishly expository? You're expecting this to sell me on the game? Blasphemous is right there!

normal.name: Boo-rittney 👑👻
normal.text: OoT formulated my childhood years. SO much female representation, it really was the first video game that taught me that games are art. The story, music--everything.

normal.name: Klaxon (slayersong) 🖇️
normal.text: The first RE team at capcom was truly ahead of the curve They invented a video game antagonist that literally encapsulated the very definition of "manipulate mansplain manwhore", indoor sunglasses and all A character so cunty they had to give him a son and a clone because they "killed" him in RE5

normal.name: Mentoch
normal.text: Can anyone recommend me new video games to play? My video card is fried, so gotta be retro graphics level. I want platformers, rogue-likes, JRPGs, etc. I want modern SNES style gaming.

normal.name: Weatherby
normal.text: backloggd.com/u/Weatherby/... I've been found guilty of playing the Old Technology, and for the crime of not "doing the math," I've been sentenced to The Cave. The only way I'll see the light of day again? Play and rank every commercially released game for the Atari Jaguar.

normal.name: Llyr
normal.text: Footage of me playing the PC version with gamepad. It was interesting getting Crashland (VR first game) working well on flat-screen. You lose a lot of spatial awareness outside VR even with headphones, so need things like threat indicators. Gamefeel screenshake, zoom, faster movement needed too.

normal.name: Aaron
normal.text: It's incredibly annoying how indie games have devalued the concept of pixel art. The vast majority of the time that just means NES quality "retro" sprites, or at best blocky generic RPGmaker game. It obscures the rare cases that use actual high effort pixel art to truly gorgeous effect.

heated.name: 💜Sonya/DJ Pomni🖤
heated.text: I'm not gonna lie, the amount of decomps and recomps using AI has made me so sad. Part of the problem is that a lot of people in retro gaming spaces see their favorite game running on PC and immediately get excited about it and don't even care if the port was vibe-coded or not

heated.text: I feel you so much on this. As MIGS this year is increasingly disappointing.
